layers.notes: defOrigin auto pins the flame's body contact (the DEF mouth) to the Head joint. The rig has no jaw/snout bone and Head's tail points up (boneTip put the flame above the skull), so the joint is the nearest pin: the flame root sits over the back of the head rather than the snout (reviewed on review_worst_row.png). render unitPlane: directional pieces (thrown/jetting forward) turn with the unit (vfx_depth.py).

Fitted: the DEF body brightens up to +16 L* on the breath keys; the mesh gets that mean rise from one point light at the head, so the head reads hotter than the DEF's broader glow (known model limit).
